name: Sajókeresztúr (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sajókeresztúr: a green and white shield with a church and ears of grain, with a helm, an arm-and-sabre crest and green and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed SAJÓKERESZTÚR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sajókeresztúr arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
